import numpy as np, requests, os, pandas as pd, networkx as nx, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def load(pid,ch):
    R={}
    for l in open(f'{pid}.pdb'):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM  ','HETATM')) and l[21]==ch and l[16] in (' ','A') and l[76:78].strip()!='H':
            rn=l[17:20]
            if rn=='HOH': continue
            k=int(l[22:26]) if rn in AA3 else ('LIG',int(l[22:26]))
            R.setdefault(k,{'resn':rn,'xyz':[]});R[k]['xyz'].append([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
    for k in R: R[k]['xyz']=np.array(R[k]['xyz'])
    return R
mind=lambda a,b: float(np.sqrt(((a[:,None,:]-b[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)).min())
R=load('4C49','C'); keys=sorted(k for k in R if isinstance(k,int)); X=[R[k]['xyz'] for k in keys]
G=nx.Graph()
for i in range(len(keys)):
    for j in range(i+1,len(keys)):
        d=mind(X[i],X[j])
        if d<4.5: G.add_edge(keys[i],keys[j],weight=d)
SITE=[18,19,22,232,240,242,260,263,264,267,366,368,371]
MOB=list(range(97,102))                       # ligand-coupled hD connecting loop segment
print('=== Shortest contact paths from each variant position ===')
rows=[]
for t in [14,89,93]:
    ps=min((nx.shortest_path(G,t,s) for s in SITE if s in G and nx.has_path(G,t,s)),key=len)
    pm=min((nx.shortest_path(G,t,s) for s in MOB if s in G and nx.has_path(G,t,s)),key=len)
    lab=lambda p:'-'.join(f"{AA3[R[r]['resn']]}{r}" for r in p)
    rows.append(dict(residue=f"{AA3[R[t]['resn']]}{t}",hops_to_steroid_site=len(ps)-1,path_to_steroid_site=lab(ps),
                     hops_to_mobile_loop=len(pm)-1,path_to_mobile_loop=lab(pm)))
P=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(P.to_string(index=False)); P.to_csv('contact_paths.csv',index=False)

# how much does each residue itself move between apo- and cortisol-bound cleaved human CBG?
def ca(pid,ch):
    return {int(l[22:26]):np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])
            for l in open(f'{pid}.pdb') if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA'
            and l[21]==ch and l[16] in (' ','A') and l[17:20] in AA3}
def kab(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))]);Rm=Vt.T@D@U.T;return Rm,qc-Rm@pc
A,B=ca('2VDX','A'),ca('2VDY','A');ks=sorted(set(A)&set(B));sel=list(ks)
for _ in range(8):
    Pm=np.array([A[k] for k in sel]);Qm=np.array([B[k] for k in sel]);Rm,t=kab(Pm,Qm)
    d=np.linalg.norm((Rm@Pm.T).T+t-Qm,axis=1);cut=max(1.0,np.percentile(d,75))
    nw2=[k for k,x in zip(sel,d) if x<=cut]
    if len(nw2)<80 or len(nw2)==len(sel): break
    sel=nw2
Pm=np.array([A[k] for k in ks]);Qm=np.array([B[k] for k in ks])
dev=dict(zip(ks,np.linalg.norm((Rm@Pm.T).T+t-Qm,axis=1)))
print('\n=== Ligand-coupled motion (2VDX apo -> 2VDY cortisol, cleaved human CBG) ===')
for r in [89,93,95,96,97,98,99,100,101,102,103]:
    if r in dev: print(f'  res{r}: {dev[r]:.2f} A')

# combined figure: allele frequency vs reported biochemical effect
gn={'H14Q':6.84e-7,'H14R':1.62e-4,'H89Y':2.33e-5,'L93H\n(Leuven)':2.49e-3,'D367N\n(Lyon)':3.43e-4}
eff={'H14Q':'affinity\nmarkedly\nreduced','H14R':'capacity\ndecreased,\naffinity normal','H89Y':'affinity\nmarkedly\nreduced',
     'L93H\n(Leuven)':'Kd 0.64->2.24 nM\n(3.5x)','D367N\n(Lyon)':'affinity\nreduced'}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0];k=list(gn);ax.bar(range(len(k)),[gn[x] for x in k],color=['#d73027','#d73027','#d73027','#d73027','#4575b4'])
ax.set_yscale('log');ax.set_ylabel('gnomAD v4 exome allele frequency')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(k)));ax.set_xticklabels(k,fontsize=8)
for i,x in enumerate(k): ax.text(i,gn[x]*1.3,eff[x],ha='center',fontsize=6.5)
ax.set_title('The three "cluster" variants span a 3600-fold range in\npopulation frequency (red = helix D cluster)',fontsize=9.5)
ax.axhline(1e-4,ls=':',c='grey');ax.text(0.05,1.15e-4,'AF 1e-4',fontsize=7,color='grey')
ax=axes[1]
rr=list(range(85,110));ax.plot(rr,[dev.get(x,np.nan) for x in rr],'o-',color='#333',ms=4)
ax.axvspan(79,96,color='#d95f02',alpha=.2,label='helix D (79-96)')
ax.axvspan(97,117,color='#1b9e77',alpha=.2,label='hD connecting loop')
for r,lb in [(89,'H89'),(93,'L93')]:
    ax.plot([r],[dev[r]],'o',color='crimson',ms=8);ax.annotate(lb,(r,dev[r]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(2,8),color='crimson',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlabel('human CBG mature residue');ax.set_ylabel('CA shift on cortisol binding (A)')
ax.set_title('H89 and L93 anchor the ligand-coupled loop\nbut barely move themselves',fontsize=9.5);ax.legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
